rca of the issue: ReferenceEditor.jsx had a missing closing `}` for PowerBundleTemplatePicker after its return JSX block at line 373. The `}` that should have closed it ended up orphaned at line 498 (between SpellConversionAtlas's closing and Row's declaration). Result: SpellConversionAtlas was declared as a nested function inside PowerBundleTemplatePicker, making it unreachable from the JSX in ReferenceEditor at line 252. ESLint correctly flagged 'react/jsx-no-undef' which CRA escalates to a build-failing error. Mitigation: moved the closing `}` from line 498 to line 374 so PowerBundleTemplatePicker closes properly and SpellConversionAtlas becomes a module-level sibling. Verified by frontend logs showing 'webpack compiled with 1 warning' (the previous ERROR is gone) and the error overlay no longer rendering on the landing page.
